tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: Find tasks by project, status, or title words; results include task IDs. Use it before updating a task the user names by title, and ask which one if several match. Not needed when the user gives a task ID.

project.description: Project name only, e.g. Design System. Exact match, ignoring case. Never put it in query.

query.description: Words from the task title, matched as a case-insensitive substring. Not for IDs or project names.

tools.name: set_task_status
tools.description: Change a task's status by ID. Call it directly when the user gives an ID such as DD-104; otherwise find the ID with list_tasks first. If it returns an error code, tell the user instead of reporting success.

taskId.description: Task ID, e.g. DD-104, as given by the user or returned by list_tasks.
